compartment: Predictors are leukocyte transcriptome and methylome and plasma small molecules; the target is a plasma protein panel. Blood is not liver.
how_to_read_runtime: Wall clock on one machine. A suspended process inflates it without computing anything, so it is never read as a cost model.
no_pharmacological_claim: EATRIS-Plus holds no drug, dose, concentration, time, enzyme activity or clinical endpoint. Nothing in this analysis is evidence about drug metabolism, enzyme activity, intrinsic clearance or pharmacokinetics, and the predictors are leukocyte and plasma measurements while the target is a plasma protein panel, so no hepatic interpretation is available either.
objective: Axis A -- multi-omic method, EATRIS-Plus v4

reporting_separation.analytical_validity: fold safety, component shortfalls, individual-set checksums, covariate completeness, the optimism of the parsimony selection, and the single-site limitation
reporting_separation.biological_relevance: families and target features, each statement carrying the compartment caveat, and none carrying a pharmacological reading

permutation_control.definition: The individual-to-target pairing is permuted before the whole cross-validation. Predictors, covariates and folds are untouched, so the component bases are identical across replicates -- an exact identity, not an approximation. The null is computed for every reported contrast, uniformly.
permutation_control.why_the_null_is_not_centred_on_zero: A wider arm shrinks harder under an inner-CV penalty, so it lands closer to the training mean than a narrow arm does and scores a slightly higher R-squared with no information at all. The null measures the size of that artefact in this exact design, which is why a small positive delta cannot be read as a finding without it.

prespecified_decision.sentence_fixed_before_the_result: If criteria 1 to 3 hold but the sibling comparison fails, the conclusion is that the ensemble predicts the masked layer and the prediction is attributable to a second assay of the same molecules, not to inter-family information.
